::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
The generative-model lineage that diffusion inherited: **autoencoder** → **VAE**
(Kingma 2013, latent-variable + reparameterization) → **GAN** (Goodfellow 2014,
adversarial training, dominant 2014–2021) → **normalizing flows** → **diffusion**,
which won by trading one hard step for many easy denoising steps.
:::

**Depends on:** [Activations & Non-linearity](../00_foundations/03_activations.qmd)
